title: My chair hasn't been a chair since March

hooks.text: My chair hasn't been a chair since March.
Everyone has a clothes chair. Here's how I got mine back.
That pile on your chair is money you're sitting on.

beats.text: My *chair* hasn't been a chair since March.
beats.visual: Tiff's bedroom. A chair buried under a tall clothes pile; Tiff stands next to it, presents it, deadpan.

beats.text: It's a pile of clothes I swear I'm going to *sell*.
beats.visual: Close on the pile: jacket, jeans, sneakers; Tiff peeks in, a $ tag pops on 'sell'.

beats.text: But selling one jacket is never just one jacket.
beats.visual: Tiff pulls a jacket off the pile and holds it up, unimpressed.

beats.text: Every app wants its own photos, its own form, its own *everything*.
beats.visual: Tiff at her desk/laptop; app forms stack up as boards behind her, one per app.

beats.text: So I list it on one app, and it just *sits* there.
beats.visual: One board shows a listing with 0 views; Tiff slumps, sleepy face.

beats.text: Resellers fix that with *crosslisting*: the same item on every app at once.
beats.visual: Six app boards light up around the jacket on a stand; Tiff points.

beats.text: More apps, more people see it.
beats.visual: Little viewer counter ticks up; Tiff happy.

beats.text: But then it sells on Depop... and *again* on Vinted.
beats.visual: Two phones ding in Tiff's hands, both SOLD; she panics.

beats.text: Now I'm refunding a stranger at *midnight*.
beats.visual: Night window, clock at midnight, Tiff crying at laptop with a REFUND stamp.

beats.text: So now I snap the pile, and *pileGo* lists it everywhere.
beats.visual: Morning. Tiff snaps the pile with her phone; a big pileGo! board appears; the six app boards light green.

beats.text: When one sells, it comes down everywhere *else*.
beats.visual: One board flips SOLD, the other five drop away; the pile shrinks.

beats.text: It's free, it's open source, and look: I have a *chair* again.
beats.visual: Empty chair, pile gone; Tiff sits on it, happy. pileGo! end card.
